[RDSC.4a.6.1] **A malformed `AlphaTest` is refused at load.** A loader **must** refuse, with `DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC`, an
artefact holding an `AlphaTest` (`proto/alfa.proto#AlphaTest`):

- whose `kind` is no member of `AlphaTestKind`;
- of kind `ALPHA_TEST_EQ` or `ALPHA_TEST_CMP` with no `literal`, or with a
  `literal` that sets no member of its `value`;
- of kind `ALPHA_TEST_CMP` whose `op` is no member of `AlphaCmpOp`;
- of kind `ALPHA_TEST_REGEX` whose `pattern` is empty, or does not compile;
- whose `slot_index` is above 254, which the field cannot hold: it has no
  marker ([RDSC.4a.9.1]).

Each of these but a pattern that does not compile is a shape of the
`AlphaNode`'s body, refused as the body is decoded, and so before a name
[RDSC.8.7] checks. Compiling a pattern is not part of decoding the body. None
of these has a meaning, and the compiler must not emit any of them. Each is a
cheap structural need of the loader under [RDSC.9.9], not a defence against a
hostile artefact.
